column1: # Section pictures of the second wave of lives: profile TAB early TAB rise TAB deeds TAB opponents TAB last TAB legacy
# (an entry the section links; "-" = none). Shortlisted by subject (a person, an event, a work or an object of the
# time the section is about), then looked at on contact sheets as the profile crops them. Left out there: present-day
# city views (Chinon, Orléans, Reims, Rouen, Konya, Xianyang, Osaka Castle among towers), maps (Zimri-Lim, Larsa, the
# Peace of Amasya), flags, logos and arms (the League of Nations, the Derg, Rastafari, the OAU, Saint-Domingue), modern
# statues and memorials (Guo Shoujing, the Battle of Yamen), another age's picture (a medieval miniature for Russian
# serfdom, the rebuilt Ishtar Gate for Hammurabi's Babylon) and a picture already used on the same profile; and Polybius's stele, of which the crop kept only the middle.
